MERGE INTO CHB_PRD_BONUS_DEAL CII USING (
SELECT #{item.seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SEQNO, #{item.tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} TRADE_ID, #{item.fprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FPROD_ID, #{item.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PROD_ID, #{item.tradeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} TRADE_TYPE, #{item.regDate,jdbcType=DATE} REG_DATE, #{item.settdateDate,jdbcType=DATE} SETTDATE_DATE, #{item.payDate,jdbcType=DATE} PAY_DATE, #{item.regTradeQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL} REG_TRADE_QTY, #{item.tradeQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL} TRADE_QTY, #{item.tradeAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} TRADE_AMT, #{item.intAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} INT_AMT, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{item.revDate,jdbcType=DATE} REV_DATE, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} REMARK, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{item.orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORG_CODE, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT FROM DUAL
) TEMP
ON (CII.TRADE_ID = TEMP.TRADE_ID)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.SEQNO = TEMP.SEQNO, CII.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID, CII.FPROD_ID = TEMP.FPROD_ID, CII.TRADE_TYPE = TEMP.TRADE_TYPE, CII.SETTDATE_DATE = TEMP.SETTDATE_DATE, CII.REG_DATE = TEMP.REG_DATE, CII.PAY_DATE = TEMP.PAY_DATE, CII.REG_TRADE_QTY = TEMP.REG_TRADE_QTY, CII.TRADE_QTY = TEMP.TRADE_QTY, CII.TRADE_AMT = TEMP.TRADE_AMT, CII.INT_AMT = TEMP.INT_AMT, CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS, CII.REV_DATE = TEMP.REV_DATE, CII.REMARK = TEMP.REMARK, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.ORG_CODE = TEMP.ORG_CODE, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SEQNO, TRADE_ID,FPROD_ID, PROD_ID, TRADE_TYPE,REG_DATE, SETTDATE_DATE, PAY_DATE, REG_TRADE_QTY, TRADE_QTY,TRADE_AMT, INT_AMT, STATUS, REV_DATE,REMARK, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, ORG_CODE, CREATE_DEPT) VALUES( TEMP.SEQNO, TEMP.TRADE_ID, TEMP.FPROD_ID, TEMP.PROD_ID, TEMP.TRADE_TYPE, TEMP.REG_DATE, TEMP.SETTDATE_DATE, TEMP.PAY_DATE, TEMP.REG_TRADE_QTY, TEMP.TRADE_QTY, TEMP.TRADE_AMT, TEMP.INT_AMT, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.REV_DATE, TEMP.REMARK, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT )
